issues.explanation: The draft reverses the 09点 harbor signal gate opening/closing order.

evidence.excerpt: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.

issues.reasoning: The cited evidence states that at 09点 on the same day the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then, and that it first closed at 10点 after opening. The current claim asserts that at 09点 it first closed before it first opened, which directly contradicts the opening-before-closing order at the same stated time.

suggested_revision.before: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first closed before it first opened.
suggested_revision.after: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.
